observations: Photo 0: A stainless steel side-by-side refrigerator with a water dispenser on the left door. A small black brand sticker is visible on the top right of the right door, but the text is unreadable. The fridge is in a kitchen setting with tiled walls and floor.

Photo 1: Both doors are open, showing the interior. The left side (freezer) has wire shelves and a light. The right side (refrigerator) has shelves, a crisper drawer, and door bins filled with items. The interior appears used, with some food items and condiments visible.

Photo 2: Left door closed, right door open, showing the refrigerator compartment and door bins. The water dispenser is visible on the left door. The interior lighting is on, and the fridge appears to be in use with stored items.
The exterior has visible smudges and fingerprints, especially on the left door. There is a small dent or mark near the top of the right door in photo 0.
The water dispenser has a black panel with buttons and a spout; no water is flowing in the photos.

identity.kind: side by side refrigerator with water dispenser

claims.evidence: The exterior has smudges and fingerprints; the interior has stored items and some food residue. 'Neat' is subjective and not clearly supported by the photos.
The interior light is on, and items are stored, but there is no proof the fridge is currently cooling or at the correct temperature. No thermometer or temperature display is visible.
The interior has stored items and some visible residue (e.g., dark object in crisper drawer in photo 1). The exterior has smudges. Cleanliness is subjective and not fully verifiable from the photos.

risks.risk: The refrigerator may not be cooling properly or may have a malfunctioning compressor or cooling system.
risks.proof: A video showing the fridge running with the door closed, and a thermometer inside showing a temperature below 5°C for the fridge and below -18°C for the freezer.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with reduced cooling capacity

risks.risk: The water dispenser may be non-functional or clogged.
risks.proof: A video showing water dispensing from the dispenser when activated.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear inside the freezer compartment or on the back of the unit (e.g., compressor, condenser coils).
risks.proof: A photo or video of the back of the refrigerator showing the compressor, coils, and connections.
risks.if_unproven: priced with assumption of potential hidden damage

risks.risk: The small dent or mark on the right door may be a deeper dent or scratch affecting the door seal or aesthetics.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the dent on the right door, showing depth and whether it affects the door seal.
risks.if_unproven: priced with assumption of minor cosmetic damage

proof_requests: Video of the refrigerator running with the door closed, showing interior temperature with a thermometer.
Video of the water dispenser dispensing water.
Photo or video of the back of the refrigerator showing the compressor and coils.
Close-up photo of the dent on the right door.
response.reason: The brand and model are unreadable, and key functional claims (chilling, water dispenser) cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks related to cooling performance, water dispenser function, and internal/external damage require additional proof before pricing can be determined.
